content.comment_body: Hello, I've provided a set of [document]s (in German, but you can find plenty of information online as well) and circuit files for generating PWM signals with [product_name]. The attached files include example circuits and core reference [document]s related to 'PWM' for different [product_name] module versions. The circuits named 'Test_PWM Signal_xxx.lsc' use the [product_name] cycle frequency as a variable timing reference for the PWM signal. Specifically, the circuits 'DEMO_PWM_Signal_für_Relaisausgang_V1 ([article_no]).lsc' and 'DEMO_3_Punkt_Regelung_mit_PWM_V1 ([article_no]).lsc' operate with a standard timing base, making use of the best resolution of 0.01 seconds. I hope these resources contain something useful for everyone (see the attachment). Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user shares a helpful collection of [document]s and circuit files to support others in producing PWM signals using [product_name] modules. The shared examples provide options for both variable reference timing via module cycle frequency, and fixed timing using the highest available resolution. These resources are practical and suited for different [product_name] module versions, offering versatility in PWM signal design.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that others will find effective PWM generation solutions tailored to a range of [product_name] series and application types, covering both dynamic and fixed reference time bases.
